upstream.description: A skill that turn any brand into a scrollable 3D world landing page

classification.analysis: scroll-world is an agent skill (SKILL.md, installable into Claude Code, Codex, and other agent hosts) that generates a scroll-scrubbed, cinematic "fly through the world" 3D landing page for any brand or industry, similar to Apple-style scroll-driven product pages. It interviews the user for brand/industry/scene details, then orchestrates AI image and video generation (GPT Image via Higgsfield or Codex, Seedance/Kling video via Monid or Higgsfield) to produce frame-locked connector clips, and wires them into a portable vanilla-JS scroll engine that drops into any HTML/Next.js/Vue stack. Aimed at marketers, agencies, and developers who want a striking generated landing page without hand-building 3D scenes, at a real per-generation cost (~$27 for a 6-scene chain).

use_cases.title: Generate a scroll-driven cinematic landing page for a brand using AI image and video models
Install a reusable Claude Code / Codex skill for building immersive product pages
Drop a portable scroll-scrub engine into an existing Next.js or Vue site
